cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Close It Properly
cards.instruction: Keep them present until both of you complete the ritual that formally ends this role, meeting, or relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you hand in your shop keys, we do the farewell bell.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm leaving because the bell rings constantly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wrap it in this towel. One last ring together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put your hand over mine for the ring. Then I'll take your keys.

reason: A actually muffles the disliked sound to retain B cooperation; replace the team-activity lesson with the concrete shared hand action and formal key handover.
